description: This is a unit test class for HibernateLocationDAO, testing retrieval of Location entities based on associated LocationTags. It sets up test data and verifies the behavior of methods like getLocationsHavingAllTags.

classes.name: HibernateLocationDAOTest
classes.description: A test class for HibernateLocationDAO, verifying retrieval of Location data based on location tags.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test method.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags_shouldGetLocationsHavingAllTags
methods.description: Tests that the DAO retrieves locations associated with all specified tags.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags_shouldReturnEmptyListWhenNoLocationHasTheGivenTags
methods.description: Tests that the DAO returns an empty list when no locations match the provided tags.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags_shouldIgnoreNullValuesInLocationTagList
methods.description: Verifies that null values in the list of tags are ignored during location retrieval.
